basis: Independent canonical ?dir=a entries at week 7, natural recorded preludes to week 0, and virtual-week 0→14→0 Discovery in desktop, portrait and landscape. Native scrollY remains zero. milestones.label: M01
milestones.observedChange: Site set-up raises perimeter fencing and the welfare cabin; by the captured week 0.6, excavation has also begun and the authored phase rows overlap.

milestones.label: M02
milestones.observedChange: Excavation removes ground inside the perimeter; by the captured week 1.6, foundations have also begun as the programme cursor advances.

milestones.label: M03
milestones.observedChange: Foundations and slab elements occupy the excavated site while the corresponding programme row fills.

milestones.label: M04
milestones.observedChange: Timber portal frames rise under the crane on the same slab during the structure phase.

milestones.label: M05
milestones.observedChange: The mezzanine floor and straight stair enter the portal frame during the floors phase.

milestones.label: M06
milestones.observedChange: Timber wall cassettes close the frame; the programme highlights the walls phase and the active piece edges.

milestones.label: M07
milestones.observedChange: Insulated roof cassettes and standing-seam roof surface enclose the same house.

milestones.label: M08
milestones.observedChange: Glazing, door and east gable openings are installed against the completed roof and wall shell.

milestones.label: M09
milestones.observedChange: Charred larch, plaster and oak finishes appear; the ten-row Gantt advances into finishes.

milestones.label: M10
milestones.observedChange: Furniture and handover pieces arrive near week 14 while the external house remains complete.

milestones.label: M11
milestones.observedChange: The automatic camera enters through the oak threshold at the first of five authored interior stops.

milestones.label: M12
milestones.observedChange: The double-height living room, hearth and bookcase follow the same house's entrance.

milestones.label: M13
milestones.observedChange: The camera turns across the first-floor kitchen, dining area and island beneath the mezzanine.

milestones.label: M14
milestones.observedChange: The walkthrough rises on the stair to the loft suite and study at the mezzanine level.

milestones.label: M15
milestones.observedChange: Week 14 ends at the upper gallery overlooking the double-height room and garden terrace.
